items.speaker: John Williams
items.role: President, Federal Reserve Bank of New York
items.occasion: The Economic Mixdown, remarks at University of Mount Saint Vincent, Bronx (as prepared for delivery)
items.quote: It is imperative that we restore inflation to our 2 percent target in a timely manner and on a sustained basis.
items.summary: Williams says the economy is strong and the labor market stable but inflation is simply too high, about 3-1/2 percent this year, driven by tariffs, Middle East energy/supply shocks and AI-related demand. He stresses policy works with a one-to-two-year lag so the Fed must stay forward-looking, and quotes the FOMC statement that more information will determine the stance. No explicit December decision is announced.
items.score_note: Inflation-dominant, forward-looking, but no explicit call for a hike or size; chose +1 as lean tighter, not +2.
